text: Each replayable call was sent to gpt-4.1-mini twice more (A1 and A2), at production's settings, through the same endpoint as the treatments. Whatever separates A2 from A1 is chance, so it is the variation production shows on its own.
Read a treatment's difference beside that gap: a difference no larger than production's own is one a rerun of production would also show. Neither figure says which output is better.
